projects.projectName: Vivli - AI Form Check Validation & Agentic Chat Automation

Risks.riskTitle: Unapproved Contract Overrun and Out-of-Baseline Delivery
Risks.riskDescription: The project is likely to continue executing PAT, regression, deployment, and hypercare beyond the contractual end date without a formally approved amendment, creating commercial, governance, and delivery exposure.

riskChain.rootCause: Remaining delivery activities materially exceed the original 16-week contractual baseline, while no formal extension or amended milestone structure is documented.

Risks.riskTitle: Sprint 5 and UAT Start Delay from Unresolved Client Dependencies
Risks.riskDescription: Open client-side dependencies are likely to delay Sprint 5 completion and the transition into PAT/UAT, causing downstream slippage across acceptance, regression, and deployment activities.

riskChain.rootCause: Critical client decisions and environment readiness items remain unresolved late in the build cycle, leaving little or no schedule buffer before PAT.

Risks.riskTitle: Late-Stage GPT-5 Mini Migration Causes Functional Regression and Rework
Risks.riskDescription: Planned migration of services to GPT-5 Mini during Sprint 5 may introduce functional, quality, or performance regression at a point when the project has minimal recovery time before PAT and deployment.

riskChain.rootCause: A material technology change is scheduled in the final build sprint, concurrent with bug fixing, enhancement handling, RBAC work, and test coverage completion.

Risks.riskTitle: PAT Sign-Off Delay from Bug Backlog and Feedback Expansion
Risks.riskDescription: PAT is likely to uncover or continue surfacing defects and enhancement requests that delay acceptance sign-off, especially given the existing bug backlog, ongoing early review feedback, and schedule compression.

riskChain.rootCause: The project is using iterative feedback-driven delivery with a substantial bug list, some items marked as enhancements, and unresolved Sprint 3/Sprint 4 review actions feeding into Sprint 5 and PAT.

Risks.riskTitle: Deployment Readiness Degradation from Compressed Test and Stabilization Window
Risks.riskDescription: The combination of delayed UAT start, unresolved dependencies, front-end testing maturity concerns, and an already extended schedule may result in incomplete stabilization before deployment, increasing the risk of go-live delay or post-release issues.

riskChain.rootCause: Testing and stabilization activities are concentrated late in the lifecycle, while the project is behind plan and still carrying dependency, defect, and scope-control pressures.
